Update docs/claude-md-archive/RULE_CHECKLIST.md with the new locations. Step 3: keep these lines in CLAUDE.md unchanged: the 2-minute waker rule, the waker guard, the Stop/PreToolUse hook rules, the overlap handoff and tail rules, the never-block-on-questions rule, the commit identity rule and the peer-message rule. Do not edit tools/automation/batch-health.sh, rig-health.sh, .claude/settings.json or any script a queued or running list uses. Do not commit. Leave the diff in the working tree and list every file you touched with its before and after size. Report with save-report.ps1 under agents/out/startup-context-cut.
